lines.text: Every iPhone,
every AI chip,
every NVIDIA GPU
depends on one company you've probably never heard of.
And it's not in America,
it's ASML, a Dutch company in a small town called Veldhoven.
And it's the only company on Earth that can build the machine
needed to make the world's most advanced chips.
The machine is called an EUV lithography machine.
It's the size of a school bus,
costs around $200 million,
and has over 100,000 parts.
Shipping one takes 40 containers and multiple cargo planes.
Here's how it works.
It fires a laser at tiny droplets of molten tin,
50,000 times every second,
creating a light hotter than the surface of the sun.
That light carves circuits thousands of times thinner than a human hair onto silicon.
TSMC, Samsung, and Intel all depend on it.
Without ASML, there's no cutting-edge AI.
That's why it's now a geopolitical weapon.
The US pushed the Netherlands to block sales of these machines to China.
And China, despite spending billions, still can't build one.
So the most important company in the AI race isn't NVIDIA, Apple, or OpenAI.
It's a Dutch company that makes machines that make chips.
If you want updates related to tech and geopolitics,
then make sure to follow our page, Things Explained.
